CONTRACT_MAJOR_MISMATCH.description: Contract major version is not supported.

CONTRACT_HASH_MISMATCH.description: Contract hash does not match the deployed interfaces.

CONTRACT_UNKNOWN.description: Contract identity is missing or unknown.

INVALID_COMMAND.description: Command schema or payload is invalid.

UNKNOWN_PROFILE.description: Motion profile is not configured or not allowed for this kind.

SOURCE_NOT_REGISTERED.description: Source module is not registered or its manifest does not match.

CAPABILITY_MISMATCH.description: Capability manifest does not match the registered module.

PROFILE_HASH_MISMATCH.description: Robot profile hash does not match the deployed configuration.

CONFIG_HASH_MISMATCH.description: Safety configuration hash does not match.

RATE_LIMITED.description: Command rate exceeds the configured limit.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.description: Idempotency key was reused with a different payload.

NO_LEASE.description: No control lease is held for the requested scope.

LEASE_PREEMPTED.description: Control lease was preempted by a higher-priority holder.

LEASE_CONFLICT.description: Control lease is held by another holder.

NOT_LEASE_HOLDER.description: Caller is not the current lease holder.

VALIDATION_REQUIRED.description: A valid validation_id is required before execution.

VALIDATION_MISMATCH.description: Validation result does not match the command.

VALIDATION_REUSED.description: Validation result has already been used.

SAFETY_STOP_LATCHED.description: Safety stop is latched; reset and re-arm are required.

SAFETY_HEARTBEAT_MISSING.description: Safety heartbeat is missing or stale.

SAFETY_FAULT.description: An active safety fault blocks motion.

STATE_STALE.description: Measured state is stale or unavailable.

JOINT_LIMIT.description: Joint position limit would be exceeded.

VELOCITY_LIMIT.description: Joint velocity limit would be exceeded.

ACCELERATION_LIMIT.description: Joint acceleration limit would be exceeded.

STEP_LIMIT.description: Single-step displacement exceeds the profile limit.

START_STATE.description: Command start state does not match the measured state.

DURATION_LIMIT.description: Command duration is outside the profile bounds.

WORKSPACE.description: TCP would leave the workspace bounds.

LOW_POSE_YAW.description: Low-pose yaw is outside the allowed range.

FK_UNAVAILABLE.description: Forward kinematics is unavailable; the check fails closed.

CONFIG_INVALID.description: Safety or robot configuration is invalid.

MOTION_BUSY.description: Another motion is executing in the requested scope.

BUS_READ_FAILED.description: Bus-servo read failed; completion cannot be verified.

MOTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.description: Motion may have been sent but its outcome is unknown; reset requires a bus check.

HARDWARE_UNAVAILABLE.description: Hardware bridge or vendor driver is unavailable.

EVIDENCE_WRITE_FAILED.description: Evidence storage failed; motion is locked out.

FORBIDDEN.description: Authenticated caller lacks the required role or scope.
